english.note: Use this for text shown on a film, video, or broadcast to represent dialogue or other sounds.

exampleSentences.english: The caption on the video lets you follow it without sound.
exampleSentences.traditional: 條片有字幕，冇聲都睇得明。
exampleSentences.jyutping: tiu4 pin3 jau5 zi6 mok6 mou5 sing1 dou1 tai2 dak1 ming4

english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for text showing film or video dialogue on screen.

exampleSentences.english: I usually turn on the subtitle option when I watch movies.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我睇戲嗰陣通常會開字幕。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 hei3 go2 zan6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 hoi1 zi6 mok6
